## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Ānán wèn shìfó jíxiōng jīng* (T492b) is the "b" recension of the paired text T492 — see [KR6i0121](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0121) (T492a) for the "a" recension. Both are attributed to [安世高](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%89%E4%B8%96%E9%AB%98) Ān Shìgāo (fl. 148–170 CE).

**Abstract**

This is the parallel recension of [KR6i0121](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0121). The two recensions provide the same essential content but with textual divergences in vocabulary, syntax, and the ordering of points. The existence of two recensions in the early Chinese canon for a text of this brevity is unusual and reflects pre-Sui canonical instability — different copy-traditions of Ān Shìgāo's translations were not harmonized into a single standard text until the Liáng-period catalogs.
